title: Walk and jog intervals 20 minutes
steps: Walk easily for 3 minutes to warm up.
Alternate 2 minutes of walking with 1 minute of easy jogging.
Keep the jog slow enough that you can still say a few words.
Finish with 2 minutes of easy walking.
mistakes: Jogging faster than you can hold for the whole minute.
Skipping the walk breaks to catch your breath.
